name: Admin proof thumbnail and modal on exact Pesanan route
description: Verify the exact /admin/pesanan page shows a transfer-proof thumbnail for an order and opens an accessible enlarged preview.

planSteps.description: Clear cookies and local storage for the site. Open the exact /masuk URL, enter admin@rafstore.id in the Email field and Admin#Raf2026 in the Password field, press the Masuk submit button, and wait until the Raf Store Admin dashboard is visible.
Navigate directly by URL to the exact path /admin/pesanan. Do not use any public-store or customer-account Pesanan link.
Verify the current path is exactly /admin/pesanan and the page shows the admin heading Pesanan pelanggan plus the helper text Verifikasi pembayaran dan perbarui proses pengiriman.

In the admin Pesanan pelanggan table, verify order RAF-TEST-PROOF-2026 for recipient TestSprite Bukti Transfer is visible with a Bukti transfer column and a visible image thumbnail labeled Lihat bukti.
Click the transfer-proof control for order RAF-TEST-PROOF-2026.
Verify a Bukti transfer dialog opens for RAF-TEST-PROOF-2026, displays an enlarged transfer-proof image, shows recipient TestSprite Bukti Transfer, and includes a Buka gambar asli link.
Close the transfer-proof dialog using its close button.
Verify the dialog closes and the Pesanan table remains visible.
